title: Top 10 Ways to De-Risk Automation
summary: Engineers know the frustration of designing a manufacturing process that is difficult to scale up or automate. Let’s say benchtop equipment was built to test an assembly process with equipment running at a slower rate to support manual loading, and the controller and servos were selected based on that rate. But when it’s scaled up, the process does not behave in the same way at the faster production rate. It may yield unrepeatable or unreliable results.... The post Top 10 Ways to De-Risk Automation appeared first on ATS Corporation .
